A calmer way to build.

Describe the experience. Forma handles the browser details. This glass surface is generated by the compiler using native CSS effects.

Forma Motion

Soft reveals, responsive hover states, and reduced-motion support built into the generated page.

Forma Materials

Translucent glass, layered surfaces, subtle highlights, and depth without a pile of hand-written CSS.

Forma Style

A coherent visual foundation with design tokens, responsive layouts, and useful defaults.

Small syntax. Real output.

Forma compiles to ordinary HTML and CSS today. Next, we will expand the parser, add tests, and build a proper component and interaction model.

Forma is an experimental open-source language project. Built for the details.
